text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: p99 latency SLO burn (> 750ms) in eu-west serving cluster. Alert group: frontend-inference-eu-west. Paging oncall rotation.@maria +1 :rotating_light:

pagerduty-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0429-0043. Trigger: p99_latency > 750ms for 15m. Pager duty link: https://pd.example/incidents/INC-2026-0429-0043

maria: ack'd and on it. quick context: we've seen tail spikes before when KV cache thrashes or when a hotkey replay hits a few workers. will grab metrics and recent deploys.

alex: looking at infra dashboards now — topology shows higher queue length on sidecars servicing seq_len 1024 workloads. p95 elevated but p99 is where we're burning.

sam: i'm pulling tracing for a handful of slow traces. early sign: many requests are getting stalled on downstream KV lookups (cache miss storm) then falling back to DB, adds ~400-800ms.

jess: tagging recent rollout: rollout/route-split-2026-04-29 at 03:12 UTC changed routing weights for eu-west to favor a new batcher variant. could be related. reverting might help.

maria: can someone run kvcache-stats on eu-west and topkeys? if a hotkey storm, we should evict or isolate.

alex: running command now:`kvcache-stats --region eu-west --top 30 --json`

pagerduty-bot: Note: escalation policy will page second oncall in 5m if not acknowledged.

sam: pasted most common keys from kvcache-stats: (redacted) top key: /user/stream/abcd1234 has 18k reqs/min to 3 shards, eviction thrash observed.

maria: that matches traces — lots of repeated prefix requests. possible replay from a client job. i'm going to isolate that prefix by adding a cache bypass rule for that keyspace so traffic doesn't overload the shared bucket. doing a temporary rule via featureflag service.

jess: +1. also recommend temporarily routing a portion of traffic to the quantized fallback model (lower mem, lower throughput but faster single-token latency) to reduce pressure on the hot path. we can shift 15% then ramp.

alex: scaling up GPU pool in eu-west by +2 nodes (reserved-dedicated-3 -> +2). kicking off scale job. ETA ~90s to start new nodes.

maria: applied cache bypass for prefix `/user/stream/` with ttl override. command: ```
featureflagctl set eu-west cache_bypass_prefix=/user/stream/ expiry=10m
```

sam: tracing after the flag shows 60% reduction in KV queue latency for affected traces. p99 fell ~200ms in the next 2 minutes.

pagerduty-bot: Update: Incident INC-2026-0429-0043 updated: mitigation steps in progress.

jess: scaling + routing + cache bypass look good. can we also roll back rollout/route-split-2026-04-29 to remove the new batcher variant while we stabilize?

alex: initiating rollback of rollout/route-split-2026-04-29 -> initiating canary rollback. command used: `routesctl rollback rollout/route-split-2026-04-29 --canary 100%`

maria: customer impact estimate: 8% of sessions in eu-west experienced >1s extra tail latency over last 20m. No major error spike (5xx) observed. tied to a small set of hotkeys.

sam: I want to keep an eye on token cost impact — fallback model increases per-token CPU but reduces waiting. tracking cost delta separately.

jess: handoff plan: i'm taking primary for the next 30m while maria rotates to secondary. alex keeps infra changes until scale complete. if p99 returns to SLO for 20m, we start a controlled remove of the bypass + rollback then reopen routing gradually.

maria: ack. leaving notes in incident doc: https://confluence.example/incidents/INC-2026-0429-0043/notes

alex: eu-west new nodes came up (node-uw3, node-uw4). Batcher pool capacity +25%. monitoring.

sam: metrics show p99 trending down: from 820ms -> 480ms after combined actions. p95 steady around 140ms.

pagerduty-bot: This incident will auto-resolve the page if acknowledgements + mitigations persist and SLOs are back within threshold for 15m.

jess: leaving a short runbook snippet for postmortem: - root cause: hotkey replay + routing change that concentrated load on a small set of batchers -> kvcache thrash. - mitigations: cache bypass for offending prefix, rollback routing change, scale pool, shift 15% traffic to quantized fallback. - next steps: add hotkey-detection alert, add per-prefix QPS throttles, tighten rollout canary for batcher variants.

maria: switching to secondary oncall channel, will follow up with customers if needed. good work team :thumbsup:

sam: adding debug artifact links to the incident doc (traces, kvcache dump, route logs).

jess: will monitor for 30m then call for close if stable.

incident-bot: Incident update: p99 latency now below threshold (last 5m avg 460ms). Auto-resolve timer started.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2026-0429-0043 marked as mitigated. If no regressions, this will be closed in 45m.

maria: closing loop: follow-up owner for postmortem: sam. ETA for writeup 72h.

jess: thanks all, great coordination.

-- end of thread --
